author_meta_policy: Biographical lifetime is not commentary publication date. Geographic label identifies origin or principal activity, not source edition printing location. Work publication dates describe historic publication, not digitization or selected English translation.

matthew-henry.geographic_meaning: Associated with the Wales–England border region; pastoral ministry principally in England
matthew-henry.work_date_scope: Commentary on the Whole Bible; completed posthumously by other ministers

john-calvin.geographic_meaning: Born in Noyon, France; principal Reformation ministry in Geneva
john-calvin.work_date_scope: Original Genesis commentary; English translation and SWORD digital editions are later

adam-clarke.geographic_meaning: Born in County Londonderry, Ireland; Methodist ministry and scholarship chiefly in England
adam-clarke.historical_work: The Holy Bible with a Commentary and Critical Notes

jamieson-fausset-brown.geographic_meaning: Robert Jamieson and David Brown worked in Scotland; Andrew R. Fausset worked in England
jamieson-fausset-brown.work_date_scope: Commentary Critical and Explanatory on the Whole Bible
jamieson-fausset-brown.historical_work: Commentary Critical and Explanatory on the Whole Bible

keil-delitzsch.geographic_meaning: German scholars who worked across the nineteenth-century German states and empire
keil-delitzsch.work_date_scope: Multi-volume series begun in German in 1861; English series published from 1863 through 1891
keil-delitzsch.historical_work: Biblical Commentary on the Old Testament

john-gill.geographic_meaning: Born in Kettering, England; ministered in London
john-gill.work_date_scope: New Testament published in 1746–1748 and Old Testament completed in 1766
john-gill.historical_work: Exposition of the Old and New Testaments
